snippet.title: Natsuki Wants It To Just Be Her & MC!!!!(Demo)(DDLC Just Us MOD)
snippet.description:
MOD Dev's Note:
hi everyone! it’s time for a new Natsuki mod release! well, the demo… but we both hope you enjoy it! by both i mean me and u/BLAZE424242 ! We both worked on this demo hard so we’d appriciate any feedback! for now have fun with this natsuki adventure! - The club in this mod has only Monika and Sayori, Sayori invites you to check out the club. You check out the vending machine and meet Natsuki. Will you two get along just fine or not?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
I Hope You Guys (OR Gals) Enjoyed This Video, I Had Fun Making This Video So Let Me Know What Mod Or Game I Should Play Next???????
